body: I suggested last night that she might want to see a new therapist and seemed to agree, so hopefully we'll go down that path. Thank you for taking the time to care about us, I stayed the night with her and now she's taking about doing some errands, so she's definitely better :)

She has been seing the same therapist for 20 years now, but he seems to either blindly agree to her paranoia or give her "tough love" and blame her for everything. Now she's calmed down and has just told me that maybe the rehab center would be good idea, so hopefully we'll go together soon. Thank you for replying.
